backseat.autoStart.description: Start polling automatically when VS Code starts (if the bridge repo is detected).

backseat.clineCommand.description: Command used to invoke the Cline CLI for the fallback path (full path if not on PATH).

backseat.clineProvider.description: Cline CLI provider id (e.g. "openrouter", "deepseek"). Empty = the CLI's own default (currently provider "cline"). Set this to match your VS Code Cline setup — the CLI does NOT inherit the extension's provider.

backseat.clineModel.description: Cline CLI model id (e.g. "deepseek-chat"). Empty = the CLI's own default (currently "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6").

backseat.defaultTimeoutSec.description: Kill a running task after this many seconds (unless the task sets timeout_sec).

backseat.heartbeatSec.description: How often to push a heartbeat status to the bridge repo while a task runs.

backseat.pollIntervalSec.description: How often to pull the bridge repo and look for pending tasks.

backseat.preferClineApi.description: Try driving the Cline VS Code extension via its API first; fall back to the Cline CLI when the API surface is unavailable.

backseat.bridgeRepo.description: Your private bridge repo as "owner/repo" or a full git URL. The extension clones it to ~/.backseat/bridge and manages it automatically — Backseat then works in every VS Code window, no folder to open.

backseat.repoPath.description: Advanced override: explicit local path to the bridge repo clone. Leave empty to use the backseat.bridgeRepo managed clone.

backseat.notifyTopic.description: ntfy.sh topic for instant pings (optional). When set, the extension POSTs a notification on every task completion AND listens on the topic so new tasks wake it up in ~1s instead of waiting for the next poll. The topic is published to notify.json in the bridge repo so your Muse can discover it. Leave empty to disable; git polling still works.

description: Backseat-drive your Cline coding agent from your phone. Polls the bridge repo for architect tasks from Muse and runs them through Cline.
name: backseat
